basic_details.job_title: DCPU Dharmapuri Support Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

age_limit.details: The minimum age for appointment as a Support Person is 25 years. The notification does not specify an upper age limit.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | support person: Postgraduate degree in fields related to child welfare, health, or education, particularly Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, or other relevant fields connected with child welfare. OR Graduates having a minimum of 3 years of experience in work related to children’s education, development, health, or protection.

salary_details.support person: Up to ₹10,000 per case, including travel expenses, paid in four instalments of ₹2,500 each. No honorarium will be paid for periods during which no cases are assigned.

selection_process: The selection process involves the screening of completed application forms and required documents submitted by interested and eligible individuals and eligible organisations engaged in child protection-related work.
how_to_apply: Go to the official website at www.dharmapuri.nic.in.
Download the Support Person application form.
Fill out the application form completely with all required details.
Attach all required documents in support of your eligibility.
Submit the completed application form in person or by post on or before 23.10.2026 to the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Old District Collectorate, Dharmapuri – 636 705.
important_instructions: The tenure of a Support Person shall be 3 years. Support Persons will work in coordination with the Police, Child Welfare Committee (CWC), District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), hospitals, courts, and other concerned institutions. Honorarium is paid only for the work undertaken in the assigned case from its commencement until its completion. Applications must reach the designated address on or before 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is DCPU Dharmapuri Support Person Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment process initiated by the District Child Protection Unit Dharmapuri under G.O. (Ms.) No. 23 to select Support Persons to assist children affected in POCSO cases.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form is 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a postgraduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, or related child welfare fields, or be graduates with a minimum of 3 years of experience in children's education, development, health, or protection.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age for appointment as a Support Person is 25 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can download the application form from www.dharmapuri.nic.in and submit it offline in person or by post to the District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Old District Collectorate, Dharmapuri – 636 705.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or honorarium provided?
faq.answer: Support Persons are paid an honorarium of up to ₹10,000 per case including travel expenses, disbursed in four instalments of ₹2,500 each, only for assigned cases.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the Support Person?
faq.answer: The tenure of a Support Person shall be 3 years.
